purpose: Record the bounded Milestone B deterministic GitHub App witness-publication and readback invariants layered on the hardened producer without claiming bootstrap authority, founder-final approval, merge authority, deployment authority, live provider enforcement, secret installation, or runtime trigger activation.

claims: src/review/deterministicReviewWitnessPublisher.ts may publish only a clear deterministic receipt produced from provider-observed PR/base/head/diff truth through the repository provider's narrow witness capability, must bind pre/post publication PR identity and exact head, and must reject success unless provider readback reports the exact derived signal from the server-owned numeric GITHUB_APP_ID.

src/providers/DeterministicReviewGitHubProvider.ts must restrict deterministic witness publication to the canonical Founder Control Room repository and exact success-only Check Run shape, must reject malformed or substituted head SHA, review hash, derived signal name, or bounded summary before provider mutation, and must reject a noncanonical GitHub API base in the normal runtime writer path so custom hosts remain test-transport-only.

src/providers/RepositoryProvider.ts exposes only a narrow optional deterministic-review witness publication capability rather than ambient generic Check Run authority, and consumers must fail closed when that capability is unavailable.

src/providers/providerFactory.ts must expose deterministic review witness publication for Founder Control Room only when GITHUB_APP_ID plus GITHUB_PRIVATE_KEY mint the repository-scoped GitHub App installation token; a local or development GITHUB_TOKEN fallback cannot mint deterministic review evidence, and a partial GitHub App credential pair must fail closed even when a fallback token is present.
